parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: IPType
parameters.description: The network type of the IP address.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return. The value must be between 1 and 50. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NatIP
parameters.description: The NAT public IP address. If omitted, traffic data for all assets is returned.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The metric by which to sort the results.

parameters.name: SourceCode
parameters.description: The identifier for the trace source.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: TrafficTime
parameters.description: The traffic timestamp to query, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds.
